dc76f66070b137fe.rationale: This `postMessage` is the main-thread side of the optional dedicated-Worker protocol qualified in #14 (docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md), not an incidental messaging side channel. The request object is built locally by this same module from typed call arguments, immediately before this line; it carries nothing the vault's synchronous in-process API would not already return to a direct caller, and the Worker host validates every inbound message against `worker-protocol.ts` before it reaches the vault. The hardening is the schema-validated protocol itself, exercised adversarially by `packages/vault/test/worker-suite.js` and `qualification/worker.mjs`.

47cd73e8e58089dd.rationale: Worker-host side of the same qualified protocol as dc76f66070b137fe: reports vault-init failure to the main thread as a typed `VaultWorkerResponse`, containing only an error code (and optional core error code, for example PII_ACTIVATION_CONFLICT), never a captured or restored value, selector, or activation identity. See docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md and, for protocol version 2, docs/decisions/2026-09-27-decide-pii-retention-and-activation-ownership.md section 3.

eefcf7e96b9af0fe.rationale: Worker-host side of the same qualified protocol as dc76f66070b137fe: sends the `vault-ready` readiness signal. Since protocol version 2 (#39) it carries exactly one datum, `piiActivation`: the core's canonical PII activation identity observed in this Worker realm (a configuration identity naming selectors and families, never input data), or null without a PII surface. See docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md and, for protocol version 2, docs/decisions/2026-09-27-decide-pii-retention-and-activation-ownership.md section 3.

c8f1e83fbd258d50.rationale: Worker-host side of the same qualified protocol as dc76f66070b137fe: reports a `WORKER_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION` for a raw message that failed `parseRequest` (including a version-1 message or any attempt to send PII selectors). Sent only when there is a valid caller id to answer; the malformed payload itself is never echoed back or logged. See docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md and, for protocol version 2, docs/decisions/2026-09-27-decide-pii-retention-and-activation-ownership.md section 3.
